aaa_enabled.summary: Configure centralized authentication (RADIUS, TACACS+, or LDAP/AD) in SMC.
aaa_enabled.notes: Configure remote LDAP or RADIUS servers under User Authentication in Forcepoint SMC (Security Management Center).

secure_vty_transport.summary: Disable HTTP management access and restrict SSH access.
secure_vty_transport.notes: Go to Engine Properties > Administration to configure secure protocol settings. HTTP WebAdmin is disabled by default.

vty_idle_timeout.notes: Modify session timeout under Engine Properties > Administration in SMC.

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: Ensure administrative account passwords are encrypted.
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: Forcepoint local passwords are automatically hashed in the internal SMC database.

no_default_snmp_community.notes: Modify SNMP community settings under Engine Properties > Add-Ons > SNMP in SMC.

http_server_disabled.notes: Go to Engine Properties > Administration and disable HTTP Web Portal.

ssh_version_2.notes: SSH configuration is managed under Engine Properties > Administration in SMC.

logging_enabled.notes: Go to Engine Properties > Logging to configure remote log forwarding to Forcepoint Log Servers or Syslog.

management_acl.summary: Restrict WebAdmin and SSH access to trusted IP hosts.
management_acl.notes: Go to Engine Properties > Administration > Access Controls to specify permitted IP addresses.

login_banner.notes: Go to Engine Properties > Administration > custom login message in SMC.

password_min_length.notes: Configure password complexity rules under SMC > Global System Settings > Password Policy.

ntp_configured.notes: Go to Engine Properties > System > Time Sync to specify NTP servers.

no_write_snmp_community.notes: Ensure SNMP communities are restricted to read-only under Engine Properties > Add-Ons > SNMP.
